sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Lindorm: Raging Titan''' possesses a strong attack power but is weak when it comes to defense. When you combine Lindorm's '''Knockback''' power with the fact that he is '''[[TCG:Unblockable|Unblockable]]''', you can take control of the Mission Map by forcing your opponent's heroes back.
